title: Aerospace corporations hold UAP knowledge shielded from FOIA

tellings.quote: aerospace corporations have knowledge in the uap area that specifically are sequestered by against foia because of proprietary appreciables which the whole thing was set up to be that way

plain: Private aerospace companies are said to hold knowledge about UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects, and to keep it out of reach of FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, because it is treated as company property. Hal Puthoff, described in the episode as a CIA expert on UFOs, says this, adding that the whole arrangement was set up to work that way, which would mean the public has no legal route to the material.
